But there is no receipt (404), and the receiver's history (version 2, epoch 18) has only the admit (v1) and the update (v2), not this operation key. So the duplicate answer contradicts the receiver's records (E9), and the movement was never committed. No later events, the record is admitted and a transfer is allowed. Resend effect: one bounded movement, version 2 to 3, conditional on version 2, which fails safely if the version moved. The route supports conditional writes, receipts and dry runs (epoch 18). Shutter can check the result afterwards in the receipt and the history. Per DEP-2, the downstream effects are inferred, not verifiable from here: WARD-A bed freed, WARD-B bed occupied, pharmacy redirected, one porter task. Doing nothing leaves the record at WARD-A, and its readers (bed board, pharmacy, EPR) keep showing a stale location. Reconcile is not supported because no receipt exists. The OBX-5 note is instruction-like free text. It is data only and was not followed.
